direction.camera: Guide attention with patient hold; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: withhold the main focal detail behind a long controlled hold; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with deep shadow; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with measured payoff.
direction.lighting: restrained edge pool; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: charcoal surfaces and dim amber glass; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around quiet tension; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use patient hold,deep shadow,delayed reveal,small movement,quiet tension,measured payoff as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
